description: Pakgen Limited — Pakgen Power Limited until June 2026 — was incorporated in 1995 and owned and operated a 365 MW fuel-fired power station at Mehmood Kot, Muzaffargarh. The company changed its name to Pakgen Limited with SECP approval in June 2026 and amended the object clause of its memorandum; in its half-yearly report it states it has not assumed any binding obligation in respect of the proposed transaction it describes, which remains subject to pre-qualification by the Privatisation Commission.
sourceNote: The company's own PSX-filed half-yearly report 2026 (directors' report and notes), the PSX company profile record, and the company website, read 2026-10-17.
